title: Nova the Squirrel
author: NovaSquirrel (Nova Storm)
licenceQuote: All code is available under the GPL license version 3 or later. Assets (graphics, levels, etc.) are available under Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International therefore the game may not be sold without permission with these intact.
notes: Puzzle platformer, author's own GitHub release asset (also on itch.io as novasquirrel.itch.io/nova-the-squirrel). iNES2 header, mapper 1 (MMC1). Mixed licence: code GPL-3.0-or-later, assets NonCommercial - redistribution is permitted but the ROM may not be sold; treat as non-commercial-only because of the assets. Controls: D-pad moves, A jumps, B uses the copied ability, Start pauses.

title: Super Tilt Bro. (release ROM, file name Super_Tilt_Bro_(E).nes)
author: Sylvain Gadrat (sgadrat)
licenceQuote: Everyone is permitted to copy and distribute verbatim or modified copies of this license document, and changing it is allowed as long as the name is changed. ... 0. You just DO WHAT THE FUCK YOU WANT TO.
notes: Smash-Bros-inspired 1v1 fighter, ATmega/NES port by the same author as the emulator itself. ROM is a free download on the author's itch.io page (upload name 'Super_Tilt_Bro_(E).nes'); itch serves it from a signed CDN URL, so the stable link is the project page. iNES2 header, mapper 2 submapper 1 (UNROM-512) - confirm the vendored core handles that mapper before publication. Controls shown in game menus; not independently replayed here.

title: 144p Test Suite (Game Boy port of 240p Test Suite) v0.23

notes: Deterministic test ROM (internal title '144P TEST'). CGB flag 0x80, so it also runs on Game Boy Color; includes tests aimed at the Super Game Boy and Game Boy Player scalers. Menu-driven, D-pad/A.

author: Simon Larsen / Tangram Games
licenceQuote: Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy of this software and associated documentation files (the "Software"), to deal in the Software without restriction, including without limitation the rights to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and/or sell copies of the Software
notes: Arcade platformer. Downloaded from the author's itch.io upload 'Game Boy rom (includes PDF manual, box art and sticker)'; the ROM inside that zip is tobutobugirl/tobu.gb (kept alone). licenceQuote: Permission is granted to anyone to use this software for any purpose, including commercial applications, and to alter it and redistribute it freely, subject to the following restrictions:
notes: Puzzle game (internal title 'LIBBET'). CGB flag 0x80, so colour-capable but DMG-compatible. Author's controls: Control Pad rolls, A + Control Pad jumps. Small 32 KiB ROM, quick to load.

title: µCity (MicroCity) v1.3
author: Antonio Niño Díaz (AntonioND / SkyLyrac)
licenceQuote: This game is licensed under the GPLv3+ license. You should have received the source code of this game along with the ROM file. If not, the source code is freely available at the following address: https://codeberg.org/SkyLyrac/ucity
notes: Open-source city builder, latest release (v1.3, Codeberg releases; GitHub AntonioND/ucity is a mirror that lags). CGB flag 0xC0 - Game Boy Color only, must be launched with the GBC/Gambatte-class core, not a DMG-only path. Uses battery-backed SRAM saves. The same release also ships ucity_compat.gbc for older flash carts; we kept the standard build. Manual in the repo (manual.rst).
